lesson: TWO fixes, both confirmed in the code; they are the quality lens's partial verdicts on t-rns-c2 and t-rns-c4. (1) use-ask.ts:126 - an ABORTED unmatched reopen (the user leaves /ask while it is pending) sets the placeholder's isPending to false but attaches neither a response nor an error, and Answer() returns null in that state, so the thread is left showing a question with nothing under it. The non-reopen path appends no turn at all on abort, so match it: REMOVE the placeholder turn on abort rather than leaving it empty, keeping 'one turn, not two' true on every terminal path. (2) ask-panel.tsx:45 - the scroll effect runs in EVERY AskPanel including surface='docked', and clears the shared scrollTargetId as soon as any matching DOM id is found, so an outgoing docked panel can consume the target and the page panel never scrolls. A reopen always navigates to /ask, which renders the page surface, so gate the effect on surface === 'page'. Cover both with leaves: an aborted reopen leaves no empty turn, and a docked panel mounted alongside does not consume the target.
